StructureDescriptions.noStructure: Your mech is damaged beyond repair – it is destroyed. You may still exit it as normal.
StructureDescriptions.crushingHit: Roll a Hull, Agility, or Systems check. On a success you become Staggered until the end of your next turn (During your next turn you can only take one quick action - you cannot Overcharge, move normally, take full actions, or take free actions). On a Failure, your mech is immediately destroyed.

directHit.base: Your mech is @Compendium[world.status-items.Impaired] and @Compendium[world.status-items.Slowed] until the end of your next turn.
directHit.one: Roll a Hull, Agility, or Systems check. On a success, you take the System Trauma result from this table and your mech is @Compendium[world.status-items.Impaired] and @Compendium[world.status-items.Slowed] until the end of your next turn. On a failure, your mech is @Compendium[world.status-items.Stunned] until the end of your next turn. If there are no valid systems or weapons remaining for Traumatized to destroy, this result becomes a Crushing Hit instead.
directHit.two: Roll a Hull, Agility, or Systems check. On a success, your mech is @Compendium[world.status-items.Impaired] and @Compendium[world.status-items.Slowed] until the end of your next turn. On a failure, you take the System Trauma result from this table, and your mech is @Compendium[world.status-items.Impaired] and @Compendium[world.status-items.Immobilized] until the end of your next turn. If there are no valid systems or weapons remaining for Traumatized to destroy, this result becomes a Crushing Hit instead.

StructureDescriptions.systemTrauma:
Choose either Traumatized or Staggered, then suffer the effects of that choice (if you are already Staggered or Braced, then you must choose Traumatized):

Traumatized:
Parts of your mech are torn off by the damage. Roll 1d6. On a 1–3, all weapons on one mount of your choice are destroyed; on a 4–6, a system of your choice is destroyed. LIMITED systems and weapons that are out of charges are not valid choices. If there are no valid choices remaining, it becomes the other result. If there are no valid systems or weapons remaining for Traumatized to destroy, this result becomes a Direct Hit instead.

Staggered:
You become Staggered (During your next turn you can only take one quick action - you cannot Overcharge, move normally, take full actions, or take free actions.). If you were already Staggered, you suffer a Direct Hit instead.
StructureDescriptions.glancingBlow: Emergency systems kick in and stabilize your mech, but it’s @Compendium[world.status-items.Impaired] until the end of your next turn.

StressDescriptions.noStress: The reactor goes critical – your mech suffers a reactor meltdown at the end of your next turn.
StressDescriptions.criticalFail: Your Mech is @Compendium[world.status-items.Exposed], @Compendium[world.status-items.Shredded], and suffers a reactor meltdown at the end of your next turn. You can end this effect by stabilizing, or by passing an Engineering check as a quick action.

meltdown.one: Roll an ENGINEERING check. On a success, your mech is @Compendium[world.status-items.Shredded]. On a failure, you take an option from Power Failure, your mech is Shredded, and it suffers a reactor meltdown after 1d6 of your turns (rolled by the GM). This effect can be ended by stabilizing, or by passing an Engineering check as a quick action.
meltdown.two: Roll an ENGINEERING check, your mech becomes @Compendium[world.status-items.Shredded]. On a success, you take the Power Failure result from this table. On a failure, you take both options from Power Failure and your mech suffers a reactor meltdown after 1d3 of your turns (rolled by the GM). This effect can be ended by stabilizing, or by passing an Engineering check as a quick action.

StressDescriptions.powerFail:
Choose either Destabilized Power Plant or Power Leak, then suffer the effects of that choice (if you are already @Compendium[world.status-items.Exposed], then you must choose Power Leak):

Destabilized Power Plant:
The power plant becomes unstable, beginning to eject jets of plasma. Your mech becomes @Compendium[world.status-items.Exposed], taking double Kinetic, Explosive and Energy damage until the status is cleared.

Power Leak:
Your mech suffers catastrophic disruption to power regulation as it tries to divert energy to critical safety systems. Your mech is @Compendium[world.status-items.Slowed] and deals half damage, heat, and burn on attacks until the end of your next turn.
StressDescriptions.emergencyShunt: Your mech’s cooling systems manage to contain the increasing heat; however, your mech becomes @Compendium[world.status-items.Impaired] until the end of your next turn.
